scope: All 8 frozen land entries in peninsula 1812, complete source intervals, including distinct Salamanca forts and July field battle. Preserve Bodart dates even where disputed.
policy: Main session only, at most3preassigned families including Bodart; at most1targeted follow-up per entry; no separate review or model job.

entries.assignment_note: Fixed before substantive new 1812 historical reading. Volumes/copies/embedded reports are one author family. Own-side evidence is preferred; gaps and mediation remain explicit.
